property_summary: For any caller who is the owner and any nonzero amount <= contract balance, calling sendTo(receiver, amount) on the correct contract decreases the contract balance by exactly amount (i.e., funds are forwarded), whereas the mutant that always transfers 0 can fail to decrease the contract balance for some fuzzed amount, violating that invariant.
change_summary: Replaced transfer with sending zero value, so state after send differs because no funds are transferred.
